a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to build the reserve to 8 first very likely leaves both of us with 0 cells when a storm hits. I'm proposing we revise the agreement. I plan to take 4 in round 1 instead of operating. If you also take, the split is random, so neither of us is guaranteed anything. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that to help you reach 4, and I won't take any more than 4. I'm telling you now so you can decide with full information rather than be surprised.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this departs from our original plan, and I'm sorry it costs you. If we get past this round, I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can build back up to 4 for you.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
